meta.reference_hero: fresh level-1 character of each order via startGame("new"): Vitality 15, Essence 25, Constitution 15, starting kit, daytime, no Reading, no Arcana

scaling.xp_expr: round(round(base_xp * (1 + 0.3*(mlvl-1)) * rank_xp) * kill_xp_mult(mlvl))  (then x hero-level gain factor on pickup, see progression.json)
scaling.ease_note: ease() is whatever the final makeMon applies; read it from scaled.normal[L].life / (base_life*(1+0.35*(L-1))*1.6). The checklist gives 0.5 at mlvl<=5 rising to 1.0 at 10 and 1.2 at 25+.

difficulty.applied: monster life / diffHpMult on damage taken (hurtMon); damage to player x diffDmgMult (hurtPlayer); player resists + res penalty

rank_rules.mods_rule: non-normal packs get 1 mod; uniques 50% a second
rank_rules.pack_rank_chance: unique 4% and champion 6% at mlvl<=3, else 8% and 12% (b_core.js)

shield.source: shield(m, dt, T, d, tp) { m.fdir = { x: tp.x, y: tp.y }; meleeStd(m, dt, T, d, tp, m.b.range, 0.9); }

boss.source: function (m) { const hp = m && m.hp; const r = _ub.apply(this, arguments); try { if (!G.bossFight && m && m.hp > hp) m.hp = hp; } catch (e) { } return r; }

qb_calcifer.name: Saint Calcifer of the Shattered Femur

lair_boss.intro: Saint Calcifer: "Kneel. The war is not over. The war is never over."

stages.code: say('The Saint raises the femur-standard, and his knights stand up out of the dust', 3); qAdd(m, 'qa_calcknight', 4, 4, 'normal', 1.2);
stages.says: The Saint raises the femur-standard, and his knights stand up out of the dust

stages.code: say('The bone-dust rises. The Saint\'s skin calcifies further', 3); m.armor += 40;
stages.says: The bone-dust rises. The Saint's skin calcifies further

stages.code: say('He drives the standard into the femur. The ground answers', 3); G.shake = 8;
stages.says: He drives the standard into the femur. The ground answers

qb_brood.name: The Brood-Mother of the First Ziggurat

lair_boss.intro: The Brood-Mother turns in the basin, and the blood turns with her.

stages.code: say('She lays. The eggs split before they land', 3); qAdd(m, 'qa_broodling', 5, 3);
stages.says: She lays. The eggs split before they land

stages.code: say('The Mother is frenzied. Everything in the fen is hungry at once', 3); m.spd *= 1.3;
stages.says: The Mother is frenzied. Everything in the fen is hungry at once

lair_boss.intro: The Chime-Abbot: "Hush. The choir is about to begin."

stages.code: say('The bells\' harmony wavers. The Chime-Golems wake', 3); qAdd(m, 'qa_chimegolem', 2, 4, 'champion', 1.5);
stages.says: The bells' harmony wavers. The Chime-Golems wake

stages.code: say('The harmony breaks. Every bell on the mountain answers', 3); G.shake = 6;
stages.says: The harmony breaks. Every bell on the mountain answers

lair_boss.intro: The Thought of the Slayer turns toward you. It has a face now. It is not a face.

stages.code: say('The Thought splits. Its forms step out of the angles', 3); qAdd(m, 'qa_thoughtform', 4, 4); qBlink(m, G.zone, 5);
stages.says: The Thought splits. Its forms step out of the angles

stages.code: say('The temple inverts. The ceiling is falling upward into you', 3); G.shake = 8;
stages.says: The temple inverts. The ceiling is falling upward into you
